body: BLOCK ACCEPTED AND AMENDED. 1535b50 is superseded by exact candidate 8b36e32d77fe692a5b38b974177723bb047134db. Amendment-only mutation changed the Observed branch to transport 0.0; the external-package test failed observed:0.0 versus observed:0.5, then the normal clone was restored byte-clean.
